title: Yellowed Smoky Algerian lamb Tagine
description: Rich and festive Algerian dish featuring tender lamb, pillowy rye bread, and smoky binchotan-charcoal flavor, perfect for special occasions.

ingredients.name: rye bread
ingredients.notes: day old, cut into 1 inch cubes

instructions: Preheat the oven to 300 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the lamb pieces and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the crushed binchotan charcoal, garlic, cumin, paprika, salt, and pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 2.5 hours, or until the lamb is tender.
While the lamb is cooking, toast the rye bread cubes in a dry skillet over medium heat.
To serve, place the toasted rye bread cubes in the bottom of a bowl, then spoon the lamb and sauce over the top.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
